name: AAIFF — Astana AI Film Festival
description: AAIFF describes itself as a festival, a community, and a distribution channel for AI-native cinema — built around the people making the films, not only the films themselves. Submissions ran from 25 May to 7 September 2026; the open call closed with 8,067 films from more than 8,000 filmmakers across 125 countries and regions, judged by an independent international jury. The festival itself runs 1–3 October 2026 in Astana, with screenings, filmmaker and jury conversations, an awards ceremony, and a gala dinner.
